metadata.title: Apple is making photo editing a big part of its AI sales pitch - MarketWatch

content.text:
CONCLUDED
11 hours ago
Apple is making photo editing a big part of its AI sales pitch
Apple is selling its new AI features to consumers in part by showing off the ways they can enhance photo editing.
The new Apple Intelligence will feature a wide array of AI-powered image manipulation and editing capabilities through a combination of Apple's on-device spatial models and Private Cloud Compute image generation. Users can describe prompts in natural language to create images in multiple different styles. Users will be able to generate wallpapers and iMessage backgrounds via AI.
Photographers will be able to enhance their photos with an upgraded "Clean Up" tool and spatial reframing capabilities that let them fix up pictures even if they were a bit too late to capture the perfect shot.
